  @VCDPA03
  Scenario Outline: Query on Patient Id and modify patient details
    Given the patient with ID <patient_id> exists
    When the user queries the patient details using ID <patient_id>
    Then the patient details are displayed
    And the user attempts to modify the patient's pin-code to <new_pin_code>
    Then the patient's pin-code is updated to <expected_pin_code>

    Examples:
      | patient_id | new_pin_code | expected_pin_code |
      | 12345      | 123456       | 123456            | # Normal value
      | 12345      | 12345        | 12345             | # Edge case - same as current
      | 12345      | 123456789    | 12345             | # Invalid value - outside the Zone

  @VCDPA04
  Scenario Outline: Create an appointment request for a patient
    Given the patient with ID <patient_id> exists
    When the user queries the patient details using ID <patient_id>
    And the user enters the following details:
      | Speciality     | Symptoms     | Consultation request/Appointment | Appointment date |
      | <speciality>   | <symptoms>   | <appointment_request>            | <appointment_date> |
    Then an entry is created in the Patient Appointment file if the appointment request is for the next day

    Examples:
      | patient_id | speciality | symptoms | appointment_request | appointment_date |
      | 12345      | Cardiology | Chest pain | Appointment       | 2023-10-15       | # Normal value
      | 12345      | Cardiology | Chest pain | Appointment       | 2023-10-10       | # Edge case - not next day
      | 12345      | Cardiology | Chest pain | Appointment       | 2023-10-15       | # Invalid value - past date

  @VCDDR01
  Scenario: Doctor sees all consultation requests and selects one
    Given there are consultation requests in the workflow
    When the doctor accesses the consultation requests
    Then the doctor sees all the consultation requests
    And the doctor selects one consultation request

  @VCDDR02
  Scenario Outline: Doctor enters diagnosis, prescribes medicines, and requests lab tests
    Given the doctor has selected a consultation request
    When the doctor enters the following details:
      | Diagnosis | Medicines (max 8) | Lab Tests (max 5) |
      | <diagnosis> | <medicines> | <lab_tests> |
    Then the prescription is updated with the diagnosis and medicines
    And the lab tests are requested

    Examples:
      | diagnosis | medicines | lab_tests |
      | Fever     | Paracetamol, Ibuprofen | Blood Test, Urine Test | # Normal value
      | Fever     | Paracetamol, Ibuprofen, Aspirin, Naproxen, Diclofenac, Celecoxib, Meloxicam, Piroxicam | Blood Test, Urine Test, X-Ray | # Edge case - max medicines and lab tests
      | Fever     | Paracetamol, Ibuprofen, Aspirin, Naproxen, Diclofenac, Celecoxib, Meloxicam, Piroxicam, Ibuprofen | Blood Test, Urine Test, X-Ray, MRI | # Invalid value - more than max medicines and lab tests

  @VCDCM01

    When the chemist accesses the consultation requests
    Then the chemist sees all the consultation requests

    Given the chemist has selected a consultation request with a prescription

    Then the medicines are dispensed

  @VCDLB01
  Scenario: Lab sees all consultation requests and selects one
    Given there are consultation requests in the workflow
    When the lab accesses the consultation requests
    Then the lab sees all the consultation requests
    And the lab selects one consultation request

  @VCDLB02
  Scenario: Lab notes lab tests, patient details, marks the flag in prescription, and adds the report
    Given the lab has selected a consultation request with a prescription
    When the lab notes the following details:
      | Lab Tests | Patient Details | Report |
      | <lab_tests> | <patient_details> | <report> |
    Then the lab tests are noted
    And the patient details are noted
    And the flag in the prescription is marked
    And the report is added

      | lab_tests | patient_details | report |
      | Blood Test, Urine Test | Patient ID: 12345, Name: John Doe | Positive for Fever |
      | Blood Test, Urine Test, X-Ray | Patient ID: 12345, Name: John Doe | Negative for Fever, X-Ray normal |
